title: Glokzin Teal Towel Ring, 6-Inch Diameter, Wall Mount Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection, Allied Brass
description: Towel ring with 6-inch diameter in solid brass for bathroom hand towels and decorative towels in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Wall mount design with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look and space-saving installation. Contemporary round ring with 2-inch projection; overall dimensions 6 in L x 6 in H x 6 in W. Includes towel ring and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Rated 10 lb weight capacity. Ideal for powder rooms, guest baths, and primary bathrooms as a towel holder near the sink. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the Foxtrot collection (designer statement, textured bathroom hardware) for matching Foxtrot and coordinated designer bath accessories by Allied Brass Foxtrot.
